rules.name: CVE-2026-33824 — Internet Key Exchange (IKE) Service Extensions Exploitation
rules.description: Detects exploitation attempts targeting CVE-2026-33824: Microsoft Internet Key Exchange (IKE) Service Extensions contains a double free vulnerability that could enable remote code execution.. Product: Internet Key Exchange (IKE) Service Extensions
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message has "CVE-2026-33824" or RuleName has "CVE-2026-33824" or ProcessName has "CVE-2026-33824" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, EventID | where count_ > 5 // AZ-ENDPOINT-006

rules.name: CVE-2026-68820 — Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock  Exploitation
rules.description: Detects exploitation attempts targeting CVE-2026-68820: Microsoft Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.. Product: Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent, AzureDiagnostics | where Message contains "CVE-2026-68820" or Message contains "WINDOWS ANCILLARY FUNCTION DRIVER FOR WINSOCK" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), clientIp_s | where count_ > 3
